passages.note: House Final Reading roll call showing Lieberman voting No on the abortion restriction bill; the page prints the voter and the count but no provision text.

passages.provision_quote: Performs an abortion knowing that the abortion is sought solely because of a genetic abnormality of the child.
passages.note: Chaptered text of the bill he voted against; its operative prohibitions are reason-based and facility- and delivery-based, and set no gestational limit or general exception list.

rows.reasoning: Lieberman voted No on SB 1457 (2021) in the Arizona House, a bill making it a felony to perform an abortion "sought solely because of a genetic abnormality of the child" and barring an abortion-inducing drug "via courier, delivery or mail service", which places him on the permissive side of the question. The bill sets no gestational limit and no general exception list, so it cannot separate "keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit." from "keep abortion legal through the second trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health." or from "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health." Direction without a stage or exception clause is not a chair.
